verdict.rationale: The Developer API is visibly versioned: the OpenAPI schema is titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) and endpoints use a /developer/v1/ path prefix (e.g. /developer/v1/transactions, /developer/v1/ai-usage/unified). However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or changelog guarantees, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a documented versioning or compatibility policy beyond the path prefix, a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
